crossRefs.note: O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but…
Be instructed, Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from you, lest I make you a desolation, an uninhabited land.”
Who is wise enough to understand this? Who is he to whom the mouth of Yahweh has spoken, that he may declare it? Why…
They have turned their backs to me, and not their faces. Although I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet…
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else…
Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.
Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from…
Who is there among you who will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come?
See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, “Will you not receive instruction to listen to my words?” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Go and tell the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem: ‘Will you not accept discipline and obey My words?’ declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words? saith the LORD.
translations.asv: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Go, and say to the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words? saith Jehovah.
